spec.referenceModel: Tesla Model Y Long Range AWD 2021
spec.drivingCharacter: Strong immediate electric acceleration, planted low-battery mass and firm, quick front response.

sources.fields: dimensions, wheelbase, tracks, tyre size, clearance, turning circle; 2021 manual pp183-187

sources.note: Public source checked2026-11-02; total power/torque explicitly marked estimates.

sources.fields: Manufacturer side/front drawing and dimensional cross-check only;2020 NA mass is not applied to the2021 EU trim.

referenceObservations.side: Continuous convex roof arc peaks ahead of B pillar then descends to short rear deck. Low rounded grille-free nose. Beltline rises slightly toward rear. Circular arches, flush handles and narrow triangular rear quarter glazing.
referenceObservations.rear: Strong shoulder haunches, sloping fastback glass, separate short horizontal trunk lip and wraparound red lamps.
referenceObservations.drawing: 2020 owner manual side drawing used to correct low nose, excessive belt height and low tail; preserve dimensioned axle centres, drawings approximate not perfectly to scale.
referenceObservations.check02: Cabin still reads detached/bubbled; needs roof-to-tail continuity and fitted pillars. Nose needs larger swept lamps; avoid repeatedly changing wheelbase/tyre physical dimensions based on perspective.
referenceObservations.check03: Added continuous painted rear pillar from roof to tail, slimmer B pillar, larger swept headlamp footprint, dark reflective glazing. Side reference from ezoomed checked locally; photo perspective exaggerates wheel/body ratio, retain manufacturer wheel dimensions.

spec.massNote: EU unladen mass published by EV Database for July2021–January2022 LR AWD; equipment and homologation convention differ from the2020 North America manual.
spec.powerTorqueNote: EV Database estimates378kW and493Nm for July2021–January2022 LR AWD; Tesla does not publish a combined peak figure.
